findings.title: North Korea Steals USD 6.36 Billion From Binance in the Largest Hack in History
findings.summary_md: TRM Labs reported that on October 29, 2026 an attacker moved about 6.36 billion US dollars out of Binance wallets across ten blockchains, the largest cryptocurrency theft on record. TRM attributed the theft to North Korea's TraderTraitor. The post was published on October 30, 2026, two weeks before this story was first seen.

findings.title: Binance Suspends Withdrawals After Crypto Hackers Steal $6.3 Billion
findings.summary_md: The New York Times reported that Binance said it had been compromised in what could be the biggest cryptocurrency heist ever, and suspended withdrawals. One research lab attributed the theft to North Korea's elite hacking unit. The report was published on October 30, 2026.

findings.title: The largest theft in history: North Korea likely behind the $6.4 billion Binance hack
findings.summary_md: Elliptic said 6.43 billion US dollars was stolen from Binance on October 29, 2026, the largest theft on record, and traced the movement of funds. The analysis assessed likely North Korean involvement. It was published on October 30, 2026, ahead of the FBI attribution.

findings.title: Binance Hack: Tracing the $6.4 Billion Theft to North Korea
findings.summary_md: Chainalysis reported that on October 29, 2026, starting around 4:20 p.m. ET, an attacker moved approximately 6.4 billion US dollars out of Binance hot wallets across multiple blockchains. The post traced the theft and discussed the response. It was published on October 30, 2026.

findings.title: North Korea is likely culprit behind $6.3bn crypto hack, 'largest heist in history'
findings.summary_md: The Guardian reported that North Korea was the likely culprit behind the 6.3 billion US dollar Binance hack and that Binance would cover all customer losses. The exchange froze 3 billion US dollars of affected assets while analysts described an unprecedented attack with laundering patterns they had not seen before. The article was published on October 30, 2026.

findings.title: FBI Links 628 Crypto Wallet Addresses to North Korea's Binance Hack
findings.summary_md: Hackread reported that in an October 31, 2026 announcement the FBI said the Binance theft occurred on or around October 29, 2026 and attributed it to the North Korean TraderTraitor group. The FBI published 628 attacker wallet addresses and asked cryptocurrency firms to block transactions involving them. The article was published on November 1, 2026.

findings.title: FBI blames N. Korea's TraderTraitor for Binance theft, urges crypto industry to block transactions
findings.summary_md: The Record reported that the FBI and US Secret Service alleged North Korean hackers were responsible for the theft of more than 6.3 billion US dollars from Binance the previous week. The bureau named the actor TraderTraitor and urged cryptocurrency firms to block transactions from the listed addresses. The article was published on November 2, 2026, ten days before the Department of Justice seizure announcement.
